cards.english_title: Democrats Take Congress After Trump’s Midterm Defeat
cards.korean_desc: 민주당은 2026년 11월 3일 양원을 이겼다. 유권자들은 생활비와 연료비, 이란 전쟁에 화났다. 민주당은 캔자스와 텍사스에서도 의석을 뒤집었다. 11월 4일 현재 최종 투표율은 불확실했다.
cards.english_desc: Democrats won the House and Senate on November 3, 2026. Voters were angry about living costs, fuel prices and the Iran war. Democrats flipped seats in traditionally Republican states, including Kansas and Texas. As of November 4, final turnout and the House majority size remained unclear.
cards.hook: Democrats won both chambers after a sweeping upset.
cards.takeaway_english: The result shifts Washington from one-party control toward open confrontation.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이번 결과로 워싱턴의 대립이 커질 전망이다.

why_it_matters.english: Congress can now block parts of the president’s agenda.
why_it_matters.korean: 의회는 대통령 정책 일부를 막을 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Investigations into the administration may become more likely.
why_it_matters.korean: 정부 조사가 더 많아질 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: High prices and fuel costs shaped a major national vote.
why_it_matters.korean: 높은 물가와 연료비가 전국 선거를 좌우했다.

parties.label: Democrats
parties.english: They gained control of both the House and Senate.

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: His party lost control after voters focused on prices, war and corruption concerns.
parties.korean: 트럼프의 당은 물가와 전쟁 문제로 패했다.

parties.label: American voters
parties.english: Their votes created a stronger check on the president’s agenda.

views.label: Associated Press
views.english: Young and Hispanic voters helped Democrats break through in Republican-leaning areas.

views.label: Axios
views.english: Cost of living and corruption were leading concerns, alongside the Iran war.
views.korean: 생활비와 부패, 이란 전쟁이 주요 걱정이었다.

disagree.english: Some Republicans may argue the result reflected local races more than a national judgment on Trump.
disagree.korean: 일부 공화당원은 지역 선거 결과라고 주장할 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Trump Accepts Defeat as Iran War Haunts Republicans
cards.korean_desc: 도널드 트럼프는 11월 3일 민주당을 축하했다. 그는 높은 물가와 이란 전쟁이 공화당을 해쳤다고 했다. 트럼프는 결과를 받아들이고 민주당과 협력하겠다고 했다. 11월 4일 중국은 미국과 소통을 제안했다.
cards.english_desc: Donald Trump congratulated Democrats after their November 3 midterm victory. He said high prices and the Iran war had hurt Republicans. Trump said he would accept the results and work with Democrats. On November 4, China offered continued communication with Washington.
cards.hook: Trump said Iran may have helped Democrats win.
cards.korean_hook: 트럼프는 이란 전쟁이 영향을 줬다고 말했다
cards.takeaway_english: Trump’s final two years will require deals with Democrats or repeated political clashes.
cards.takeaway_korean: 트럼프는 민주당과 협상하거나 계속 충돌해야 한다.

why_it_matters.english: The president will face stronger congressional resistance.
why_it_matters.korean: 대통령은 더 강한 의회 저항을 받는다.

why_it_matters.english: The Iran war has affected both foreign policy and fuel prices.
why_it_matters.korean: 이란 전쟁은 외교와 연료비에 영향을 줬다.

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: He accepted the results and said he would work with Democrats.
parties.korean: 트럼프는 결과를 인정하고 민주당과 협력하겠다고 했다.

parties.label: China
parties.english: China said it wanted continued communication and cooperation with the United States.
parties.korean: 중국은 미국과 소통과 협력을 계속 원했다.

parties.label: Elon Musk
parties.english: He joked that his spending and political influence had failed.
parties.korean: 일론 머스크는 자신의 영향력이 실패했다고 농담했다.

views.label: Donald Trump
views.english: He said the Iran war played a part but defended the importance of his policy.
views.korean: 트럼프는 이란 전쟁이 영향을 줬지만 정책은 중요하다고 했다.

views.label: Democrats
views.english: They presented the result as a demand for lower costs and more oversight.
views.korean: 민주당은 유권자가 물가 인하와 감시를 원했다고 말했다.

disagree.english: Critics may say Trump acknowledged the war’s effect without accepting personal responsibility.
disagree.korean: 비판자들은 트럼프가 개인 책임을 피했다고 말할 수 있다.

cards.korean_title: 하킴 제프리스, 첫 흑인 하원의장 눈앞
cards.english_title: Hakeem Jeffries Nears Historic House Speaker Role
cards.korean_desc: 하킴 제프리스는 민주당 승리 뒤 하원의장에 가까워졌다. 당선되면 그는 첫 흑인 하원의장이 된다. 그는 물가 대책과 트럼프 정부 조사를 약속했다. 11월 4일 민주당 진보파와 중도파는 여전히 달랐다.
cards.english_desc: Hakeem Jeffries moved toward becoming House speaker after Democrats won the chamber. If elected, he would be the first Black person to hold the post. He has promised action on costs while investigating the Trump administration. On November 4, progressive and moderate Democrats still faced policy disagreements.
cards.hook: Hakeem Jeffries could become the first Black House speaker.
cards.korean_hook: 하킴 제프리스가 첫 흑인 의장에 가까워졌다
cards.takeaway_english: Jeffries faces history outside the chamber and a difficult coalition inside it.
cards.takeaway_korean: 제프리스는 역사와 당내 갈등을 동시에 마주한다.

why_it_matters.english: The speaker controls which House bills receive attention.
His choices could affect healthcare and household costs.
why_it_matters.korean: 그의 선택은 의료와 가계비에 영향을 준다.

parties.label: Hakeem Jeffries
parties.english: He is expected to lead the Democratic House majority.
parties.korean: 그는 민주당 하원 다수당을 이끌 전망이다.

parties.label: Progressive Democrats
parties.english: Some want stronger commitments on healthcare, housing and voting rights.
parties.korean: 일부 진보파는 의료와 주거, 투표권을 원한다.

parties.label: Moderate Democrats
parties.english: They may resist policies they consider too costly or too far left.
parties.korean: 중도파는 너무 비싼 정책에 반대할 수 있다.

views.label: Associated Press
views.english: Jeffries represents a historic change but must balance speed with consensus.

views.label: Progressive Democrats
views.english: They want him to support universal healthcare, public housing and voting reforms.

disagree.english: Moderates may argue that moving too far left could split the new Democratic majority.
disagree.korean: 중도파는 지나친 좌향 이동이 당을 나눌 수 있다고 본다.

cards.korean_title: 인도계 후보들, 미국 선거서 엇갈린 성적
cards.english_title: Indian-American Candidates Win Some, Lose One Big Race
cards.korean_desc: 수하스 수브라마냠과 피아 단디야는 11월 3일 하원에 당선됐다. 두 사람의 승리는 의회에 인도계 목소리를 더했다. 비벡 라마스와미는 민주당 에이미 액턴에게 졌다.
cards.english_desc: Suhas Subramanyam and Pia Dandiya won House seats on November 3. Their victories added Indian-American voices to Congress. Vivek Ramaswamy lost Ohio’s governor race to Democrat Amy Acton.
cards.hook: Two Indian-American Democrats won House seats; Vivek Ramaswamy lost.
cards.korean_hook: 인도계 민주당원 둘은 이겼고 라마스와미는 졌다
cards.takeaway_english: Indian-American representation grew, but the political map remained mixed.

why_it_matters.english: More diverse lawmakers can bring different community concerns into Congress.
why_it_matters.korean: 더 다양한 의원들이 지역 문제를 의회에 가져온다.

why_it_matters.english: The results show that identity did not guarantee one party’s success.
why_it_matters.korean: 정체성만으로 한 정당의 승리를 보장하지 못했다.

parties.label: Suhas Subramanyam
parties.english: He won reelection in Virginia’s 10th congressional district.

parties.label: Vivek Ramaswamy
parties.english: He lost Ohio’s governor’s race to Democrat Amy Acton.
parties.korean: 비벡 라마스와미는 오하이오 주지사 선거에서 졌다.

views.label: Business Standard
views.english: The results showed a mixed outcome for Indian-American candidates.
views.korean: 결과는 인도계 미국 후보들의 혼합된 성적을 보여줬다.

views.label: New Indian Express
views.english: The wins reflected growing political participation among Indian Americans.
views.korean: 승리는 인도계 미국인의 정치 참여를 보여줬다.

disagree.english: Others may see the races as separate contests rather than evidence of one community-wide trend.
disagree.korean: 다른 사람들은 각 선거를 별개의 경쟁으로 볼 수 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 이 결과는 더 큰 정치 변화를 보여줄까요?

cards.english_title: Green Hydrogen Could Drain North Africa’s Water
cards.korean_desc: 연구는 북아프리카 수소 수출이 물과 해양 생물을 해칠 수 있다고 경고했다. 이 지역은 재생에너지는 풍부하지만 물이 부족하다. 수소 생산은 재생 전기로 물을 나눈다. 최근 연구는 담수화가 경쟁을 줄이지만 염수를 만든다고 했다.
cards.english_desc: A study warned that North African hydrogen exports could harm water and marine life. The region has excellent renewable resources but very limited water. Making hydrogen splits water into hydrogen and oxygen using renewable power. Updated research says desalination could reduce freshwater competition but create salty waste.
cards.hook: Clean hydrogen may create a dirty water problem.
cards.sticker: The hidden cost of clean fuel
cards.korean_hook: 청정 수소가 물 문제를 만들 수 있다
cards.takeaway_english: The hydrogen race needs water rules as carefully as energy targets.
cards.takeaway_korean: 수소 경쟁에는 에너지 목표만큼 물 규칙도 필요하다.

why_it_matters.english: Energy projects can compete with households, farms and ecosystems for water.
why_it_matters.korean: 에너지 사업은 가정과 농장, 생태계와 물을 다툴 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: A fuel labelled clean can still create local environmental costs.
why_it_matters.korean: 청정 연료도 지역 환경 비용을 만들 수 있다.

parties.label: North Africa
parties.english: The region has strong solar and wind resources but severe water shortages.
parties.korean: 북아프리카는 태양과 바람은 많지만 물이 부족하다.

parties.label: European buyers
parties.english: They see green hydrogen as a possible fuel for difficult industrial sectors.
parties.korean: 유럽 구매자들은 녹색 수소를 산업 연료로 본다.

parties.label: Local communities and ecosystems
parties.english: They could face competition for water and harm from salty wastewater.
parties.korean: 지역사회와 생태계는 물 경쟁과 염수 피해를 겪을 수 있다.

views.label: The study
views.english: Large exports could worsen groundwater stress and damage marine life.
views.korean: 대규모 수출은 지하수와 해양 생물을 해칠 수 있다.

views.label: European hydrogen planners
views.english: Desalination, wastewater and brackish water could reduce pressure on freshwater.
views.korean: 담수화와 폐수는 담수 압박을 줄일 수 있다.

disagree.english: Supporters may argue that careful design can avoid freshwater use and support clean industry.
disagree.korean: 지지자들은 설계로 담수 사용을 피할 수 있다고 말한다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 물 위험이 남아도 유럽은 수소를 수입해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Isaac Herzog Holds Israel’s Coalition Key
cards.korean_desc: 아이작 헤르초그 대통령은 11월 4일 과반 없는 선거 뒤 협의를 시작했다. 네타냐후 진영과 아이젠코트 진영 모두 61석에 못 미쳤다. 선거관리위원회는 11월 4일 부정이 없었다고 말했다.
cards.english_desc: President Isaac Herzog began consultations on November 4 after Israel’s election produced no majority. Neither Netanyahu’s camp nor Eisenkot’s bloc reached the 61-seat threshold. The election commission said on November 4 that it found no fraud.
cards.hook: No Israeli bloc won enough seats to govern alone.
cards.korean_hook: 이스라엘 어느 진영도 단독 과반을 얻지 못했다
cards.takeaway_english: Herzog’s quiet constitutional role has become the loudest question in Israeli politics.
cards.takeaway_korean: 헤르초그의 조용한 권한이 정치의 핵심이 됐다.

why_it_matters.english: The choice may decide whether Israel forms a government or holds another election.
why_it_matters.korean: 선택은 정부 구성이나 재선거를 결정할 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Coalition deals could change Israel’s direction after years of conflict.
why_it_matters.korean: 연정 협상은 이스라엘의 방향을 바꿀 수 있다.

parties.label: Isaac Herzog
parties.english: He must choose which candidate has the best chance to form a coalition.
parties.korean: 헤르초그는 연정을 만들 후보를 선택해야 한다.

parties.label: Benjamin Netanyahu
parties.english: His Likud party remains central to the government negotiations.

parties.label: Gadi Eisenkot
parties.english: His opposition bloc wants to replace Netanyahu but lacks a simple path.

views.label: Herzog’s position
views.english: The president should choose the candidate most able to build a government, not simply the largest party.
views.korean: 대통령은 가장 큰 당보다 정부를 만들 후보를 골라야 한다.

views.label: Opposition bloc
views.english: Eisenkot’s supporters say their broader coalition may offer the clearest route to change.
views.korean: 야권은 더 넓은 연정이 변화의 길이라고 말한다.

disagree.english: Netanyahu’s camp may argue that the largest party should receive the first chance to govern.
disagree.korean: 네타냐후 진영은 최대 정당이 먼저 기회를 받아야 한다고 본다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 대통령은 최대 정당과 강한 연정 중 무엇을 골라야 할까요?
